notes.title: Bug Fix: 11 Jan 2023
notes.notes:
- Fasten the camera transition during spawning.Previous camera transition is too long, making it annoying
- Player can get 'stuck' at the edge of the platform, this enable player to cheat and jump again although
  player should be falling.
- Disable collider for wooden beam when fully retract, player can cheat by going to start of wooden beam
   and stay afloat when wooden beam fully retract.
- Fix level 1 and level 2 minor cosmetic & platforming issue.

notes.title: Minor Game Update (1 Jan 2023)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added tutorial for movement keys on the first level (movement, run and jump keys etc)
[*] Increase default mouse sensitivity to 7.0 (Player complained default mouse sensitivity is too low)
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix (Slippery after landing from jump bug)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

There's a bug which I I earlier ignored as minor issues which is:

[b]After you jump and landed on groud, you will move forward as if you landed on slippery ice.[/b]

Watching some gameplay footage and complains from other players,I realize it's a major issue.
I had now patched this bug.

Thanks,
Gamester
